long_biography.plain_text:
Before creating Churchill, Kenneth Kencel worked across leveraged finance and merchant banking, including leadership posts at Royal Bank of Canada and Indosuez Capital. He established Churchill Financial with colleagues in 2006 to lend to private-equity-backed middle-market companies. Olympus Partners acquired the business, and Carlyle later bought its lending operation.

Kencel reunited the strategy with former colleagues under TIAA in 2015. He leads Churchill Asset Management and co-leads Nuveen Private Capital, while chairing several publicly registered lending companies. A Georgetown business graduate and Northwestern-trained lawyer, he also serves on educational and charitable advisory bodies and has played guitar since childhood.
